newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Dini says Ecofin unlikely before EU summit.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Dini says Ecofin unlikely before EU summit.

text.p: Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini said on Wednesday he thought it was unlikely that European Union finance ministers would hold an emergency meeting ahead of the forthcoming EU summit in Amsterdam.
Dini told parliament he thought it was more likely that finance ministers would meet in parallel to next week's Amsterdam summit.

The Dutch EU presidency said on Tuesday it could not rule out an extra session of European Union finance ministers (ECOFIN) ahead of the Amsterdam summit after the French unexpectedly demanded more time to evaluate the stability pact.

The pact, which is designed to enforce fiscal restraint in EMU member states, was originally due to be signed by EU heads of state in Amsterdam, but there is now uncertainty over whether this can be achieved.
Asked by reporters whether he expected an Ecofin meeting before Monday, Dini replied: "This is improbable...a more useful route would be to hold a parallel meeting inside (the Amsterdam) summit."
